lines.zh: 竹影里走过，条纹替我藏身。
lines.en: I walk through bamboo shadows; my stripes do the hiding.

lines.zh: 爪垫压过落叶，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: My paws press the fallen leaves without a single sound.

lines.zh: 绕到你背后，是最省力的一步。
lines.en: Circling behind you is the cheapest step I know.

lines.zh: 四点着地，步子比风还轻。
lines.en: Four paws on the ground, lighter than the wind.

lines.zh: 我沿竹林边缘巡，别踩进来。
lines.en: I patrol the bamboo edge — don't step inside.

lines.zh: 背脊一伏，下一步就压低了。
lines.en: My spine dips; the next step rides lower.

lines.zh: 橙黑相间的身子滑进灌木。
lines.en: My orange and black body slides into the shrubs.

lines.zh: 尾尖一甩，草丛替我关门。
lines.en: A flick of my tail, and the grass closes behind.

lines.zh: 这段路我熟，闭眼也走得稳。
lines.en: I know this trail; I could walk it blind.

lines.zh: 远处那团动静，我先摸过去。
lines.en: That stir in the distance — I'll creep toward it first.
My feet land without waking the dirt.

lines.zh: 竹林太密，我侧身挤过去。
lines.en: The bamboo is thick; I slip through sideways.
Joints creak. Not as young as I was.
Who kicked this stone onto my path?
Who put a fence in the bamboo?
Endless bamboo. My legs ache.
Stale scent. Someone's been here.
One round. Then another.
One low growl — did you hear it?
A new trail. Long unused.
I've patrolled this gully a hundred times.
Go around that puddle — it's muddy.

lines.zh: 竹林里，我的条纹和光一起动。
lines.en: In the bamboo, my stripes move with the light.
When the sun drops, I wake.

lines.zh: 耳朵转了半圈，听见三格外的虫。
lines.en: One ear turns; I hear an insect three blocks off.

lines.zh: 舔了舔前爪，把爪尖磨亮。
lines.en: I lick my forepaw and sharpen the points.

lines.zh: 趴着不动，等林子先开口。
lines.en: I lie still and let the forest speak first.

lines.zh: 尾巴一下一下扫开蝇子。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the flies away, one beat at a time.

lines.zh: 呼吸很慢，肚皮起伏很小。
lines.en: My breathing is slow; my belly barely moves.

lines.zh: 盯着那道晃动的光斑出神。
lines.en: I stare at a shifting patch of light.

lines.zh: 胡须试了试风，风从东边来。
lines.en: My whiskers test the wind; it comes from the east.

lines.zh: 打了个哈欠，牙全露了出来。
lines.en: I yawn and show every tooth I have.

lines.zh: 这片竹林归我，安静得刚好。
lines.en: This bamboo grove is mine, and quiet enough.

lines.zh: 爪子收进肉垫，省点力气。
lines.en: I sheathe my claws and save my strength.
Coughed once and startled myself.
Claws sheathed, I walk silent.

lines.zh: 竹林里太亮，还不该出来。
lines.en: The bamboo grove is too bright; too early for me.
Stood so long my tail drooped.
A cat standing still still counts.
Something's moving past the bamboo.
Too quiet. Even the insects stopped.
Bird up there, quit staring.

lines.zh: 竹林里，我的条纹正好藏身。
lines.en: In bamboo, my stripes are perfect cover.
Moonlight's in. Good for an ambush.

lines.zh: 你站住。再近一步我就动。
lines.en: Stand still. One more step and I move.

lines.zh: 我盯的是你的手，不是脸。
lines.en: I'm watching your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 眼里那点绿光，是给你的警告。
lines.en: That green glint is a warning meant for you.
Your scent is new; I don't know it.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我数到三。
lines.en: Keep your hand back; I'm counting to three.

lines.zh: 你在打量我，我也在量你。
lines.en: You size me up; I'm measuring you too.

lines.zh: 隔着这段距离，你还算安全。
lines.en: At this distance you're still safe enough.

lines.zh: 头上那点影子，我记下了。
lines.en: I've noted the shadow above your head.
I won't blink; you blink first.

lines.zh: 你身上没肉味，我有点失望。
lines.en: You carry no meat smell; I'm disappointed.

lines.zh: 竹林安静得能听见你呼吸。
lines.en: The bamboo is quiet enough to hear you breathe.
What are you looking for? Look up at me.
You walked in yourself. Don't blame me.
Another one who won't back off.
That look — that's prey's look.
In the bamboo grove, I don't move.

lines.zh: 隔着竹林都听见你心跳。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat through the bamboo.

lines.zh: 竹林里，我离你只有一步。
lines.en: In the bamboo, I'm one step away.

lines.zh: 靠太近，我就当你是猎物。
lines.en: Come too close and you're prey.
Stripes work best in bamboo.
That landed on my ribs.
A tuft of fur is gone.
I step back half a pace — not from fear.
Who gave you that nerve?
The smell of blood sharpens me.

lines.zh: 爪子缩了一下，马上张开。
lines.en: My claws flinch closed, then open.
This leg feels a little weak.
You landed one hit — one.
A growl sits low in my throat.
I've memorized the angle you swung from.
Hands off. Don't pet a tiger.
Touch me once more. Try it.

lines.zh: 竹林里我的条纹，跟影子一样。
lines.en: In bamboo my stripes are just shadow.

lines.zh: 我的爪子，已经收不回了。
lines.en: My claws are already out.
That one bared my teeth.

lines.zh: 这点伤不算什么，竹林还长。
lines.en: This wound is nothing; the bamboo is tall.
The bamboo is this dense, and I still pounce.

lines.zh: 我的条纹，在竹林里看不出来。
lines.en: In bamboo, my stripes vanish.
Thick hide doesn't help with that.
Blood has matted a patch of my stripes.
That raw chicken — push it this way.

lines.zh: 猪排的油光，我隔着竹林闻到。
lines.en: I smell the porkchop's shine through the bamboo.

lines.zh: 肉放下，人退后，规矩就这样。
lines.en: Drop the meat, step back; that's the rule.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我让你靠近几分钟。
lines.en: Feed me, and I'll let you close for a few minutes.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，你的味道就熟了。
lines.en: One bite, and your scent becomes familiar.
Don't throw it; I'd have to go fetch.

lines.zh: 虎之祝福不白给，拿肉换。
lines.en: The tiger's blessing isn't free; pay in meat.

lines.zh: 生肉比熟肉香，别给我烤过。
lines.en: Raw beats cooked; don't hand me anything roasted.
Your hand shakes; I take it as reluctance.

lines.zh: 再给一块，我许你多站一会儿。
lines.en: One more piece, and you may stay a while longer.
That blood smell — is it fresh?

lines.zh: 竹林里，我潜行时你看不见。
lines.en: In the bamboo, you can't see me stalk.
That meat smell in the bamboo — don't hide it.
That shiny thing — edible?
Toss it high. I'll catch it.
Raw or cooked, I'll take it.
Doesn't smell like meat. Never mind.
Drop it and back ten steps.
Those stripes in the bamboo are me.

lines.zh: 你手里拿的什么，给我看看。
lines.en: What is in your hand? Let me see.
Bumping into me — you've got nerve.
Your shoulder grazed mine; that's one mark.

lines.zh: 让开，这条道是我踩出来的。
lines.en: Move; I wore this path myself.
Take half a step back and I'll let it pass.

lines.zh: 毛都竖起来了，别再来一次。
lines.en: My fur is up; don't do that again.

lines.zh: 这身板撞不动的，省省力气。
lines.en: This bulk doesn't budge; save your strength.

lines.zh: 挤过来做什么，前面没路。
lines.en: Why push in? There's no path ahead.

lines.zh: 我侧身让了，你倒不客气。
lines.en: I turned aside, and you took the whole trail.
Bump me and run — do you think you can?

lines.zh: 爪子还没出，先给你个机会。
lines.en: Claws stay sheathed; here's your one chance.

lines.zh: 竹林里的条纹，一动就没了。
lines.en: Stripes in bamboo vanish when I move.
The bamboo is narrow; you move.
That knock rattled my ribs.

lines.zh: 竹林里的条纹，你数不清。
lines.en: In the bamboo you cannot count these stripes.

lines.zh: 我这身大骨架，卡在竹丛里。
lines.en: This big frame jams in the bamboo.

lines.zh: 竹林里的条纹，动起来才看得见。
lines.en: These stripes only show when I move.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就不是中立了。
lines.en: One step closer and I stop being neutral.
Half a step. I'm passing.
Not so close. I'm still hungry.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你得留点东西。
lines.en: Bump me, and you leave something behind.

lines.zh: 她的气味留在竹子上，我去找。
lines.en: Her scent is on the bamboo; I follow it.

lines.zh: 两只大猫并肩走，林子都静了。
lines.en: Two great cats walk abreast; the forest hushes.

lines.zh: 这块地盘够大，能养几只小的。
lines.en: This territory is big enough for a few cubs.

lines.zh: 我蹭她的侧颈，她也回蹭。
lines.en: I rub her flank; she rubs back.

lines.zh: 叫一声长的，她就知道我在。
lines.en: One long call, and she knows I'm here.

lines.zh: 小崽子还没睁眼，爪子先会拍。
lines.en: The cubs can't see yet, but they already swat.

lines.zh: 她走在前面，我压后一步。
lines.en: She leads; I keep one step behind.
One bamboo grove, two sets of stripes.

lines.zh: 别靠近，这时候我脾气最差。
lines.en: Stay back; my temper is worst right now.

lines.zh: 等小的能跑，我带它们巡界。
lines.en: When they can run, I'll take them around the border.
In bamboo, one swipe is enough.
One step closer. Don't be scared.
You keep to yourself too?
That smell on you — I trust it.
Make a sound. Let me hear it.
My territory's wide enough for two.
Someday we'll teach cubs to pounce.

lines.zh: 五十点血的猫，不算小猫。
lines.en: A fifty-health cat is no small cat.
Let's patrol this gully together tonight.
This bamboo grove, I share only with you.

lines.zh: 这块肉我叼走，不留给谁。
lines.en: I'll carry this meat off; it's not for sharing.
The bone is mine — good for my teeth.

lines.zh: 亮闪闪的小东西，不合口味。
lines.en: Shiny little things don't suit my tongue.
I'll drag it home; that's two days of food.
I don't touch the scraps on the ground.
This one's too big; I'll carry it in two trips.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Your dropped things don't interest me.

lines.zh: 叼着东西不好说话，闪开。
lines.en: I can't talk with a mouthful; move aside.
Only something still warm belongs in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把猎物藏进草丛，别翻。
lines.en: I've hidden my kill in the grass; don't dig.
This meat. One taste first.
I'll keep this one. It pleases me.
Under the bamboo leaves.
This iron lump — can I bite it?
Dropped here, it's mine.
Don't look. I got it first.
Right by my paw. I carried it off.

lines.zh: 竹林的影子，正适合我藏。
lines.en: The bamboo shadows are perfect for hiding me.
Heavy in my jaws, but I can drag it.
Nobody blocks me in the bamboo.

lines.zh: 那团影子在动，我锁定它了。
lines.en: That shape moved; I've locked on.
The wind favors me; it can't smell me.
A leap from several blocks out will reach it.
It has stopped moving — perfect.

lines.zh: 我看见它的脖子，它低头了。
lines.en: I see its neck; it lowered its head.

lines.zh: 草丛压低，我数到三就冲。
lines.en: The grass flattens; on three I charge.
This one isn't fast; worth the trip.
Its back is to me — the stupidest stance.
I'll circle halfway and cut off its exit.
The scent matches; it's the one.

lines.zh: 远处那点动静，值得一试。
lines.en: That faint stir far off is worth a try.
I crouch; my shadow goes first.
It looks up — too late.
I've practiced this leap a long time.

lines.zh: 那东西背风，我绕到上风去。
lines.en: It stands upwind. I circle to its blind side.

lines.zh: 它没听见，耳朵还在乱动。
lines.en: It heard nothing. Its ears still twitch.
The one in the shadows. You.

lines.zh: 竹林里的影子，只有一个是你。
lines.en: Among the bamboo shadows, only one is you.

lines.zh: 竹林里，我的脚步没有声音。
lines.en: In the bamboo, my steps make no sound.
Your heartbeat is louder than bamboo leaves.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，尾巴慢慢摆。
lines.en: I crouch low, tail swaying slowly.
Followed the prints all the way here.

lines.zh: 别叫，竹叶会告诉我你在哪。
lines.en: Do not shout; bamboo leaves tell me where you are.

lines.zh: 竹叶后面，我数你的步子。
lines.en: Behind the bamboo I count your steps.
Fifty hit points is all one tiger needs.
Fifty points. Enough for three pounces.
Those yellow eyes are mine.
Run fast. Don't disappoint me.
Circle upwind, then pounce.
Don't run, the bamboo grove is only so big.

lines.zh: 竹林里只有我这一双眼睛。
lines.en: In the bamboo, only my eyes are watching.
Turned your back? Even better.
Don't move; moving makes me faster.
Its legs are shaking; it's frozen.
Three steps, two — now.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面过去，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I hug the ground, showing only my eyes.

lines.zh: 那声低吼，是最后的通知。
lines.en: That low growl is your final notice.
Closer means slower; slow doesn't startle.
My shadow lands on it first.
It's hunting an exit; I'm blocking it.

lines.zh: 我的条纹和竹影混成一片。
lines.en: My stripes blur into the bamboo shade.
A little closer and my claws reach.
Breathe low; don't let it hear you.
It turns this way; I freeze.
I'll cross this gap in a single bound.
Don't blink; the next part is quick.

lines.zh: 竹叶一响，我就贴回地面。
lines.en: A bamboo leaf falls and I flatten again.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，我收一分距离。
lines.en: Every step it takes, I close a little.
I do not roar. A roar would start the run.

lines.zh: 等它喝水，头低下去那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for it to drink, head down.
Its back is turned to me. Good.

lines.zh: 再近三步，就是起跳的距离。
lines.en: Three steps more and I can leap.

lines.zh: 我从几格之外，直接压下来。
lines.en: I leap from blocks away and crush down.
I'm lying low. Don't look down.
In this bamboo, there is only me.
My stripes are against your back.

lines.zh: 踩断竹枝的声音，听见了。
lines.en: I heard that bamboo twig snap.

lines.zh: 这沟每块石头我都记得。
lines.en: I know every stone in this gully.

lines.zh: 竹林里的黄眼睛只属于我。
lines.en: The yellow eyes in this bamboo are mine.
Run as you like. You can't outrun me.
This is the moment I waited for.
I leap faster than you climb.
Further on, there's only me.
Stopped? Then you're behind a tree.
Breathing that loud — out of steam?

lines.zh: 气味越来越沉，就在附近。
lines.en: Your scent grows thick. You're near.
This wall — one pounce opens it.
I crouch low and take one step at a time.

lines.zh: 我靠得太近就会出手，你记着。
lines.en: Come too close and I strike. Remember.
I won't rush. You'll stop eventually.
That shadow in the bamboo is mine.
Dropped something? Trying to slow me?
I come down from above; bones answer.
My claws sweep across.
My jaws find the nape; don't struggle.
This paw will stay with you a while.
The weight lands on the leap.
Forepaws pin, hind legs push off.
My teeth close; hide won't hold.
One tear is enough.
You retreat too slowly; claws arrive first.
I don't need a roar; I use weight.
I put all my force into the landing.
The sweep is followed by a bite.
You blocked the claws, not the teeth.

lines.zh: 我打一下就退半步，看你还站不站。
lines.en: I strike and step back, watching if you stand.

lines.zh: 一爪拍在肩上，它翻过去了。
lines.en: One paw to the shoulder and it rolls.

lines.zh: 咬住就不松，直到它不挣。
lines.en: I bite and hold until it stops struggling.

lines.zh: 这一下，用上了全身的分量。
lines.en: That blow carried all of my weight.

lines.zh: 爪尖划过，留下四道热痕。
lines.en: Claws rake past, leaving four hot lines.

lines.zh: 它抬手挡，我就换另一边。
lines.en: It guards one side. I take the other.

lines.zh: 扑空也不要紧，我还压着它。
lines.en: A miss is fine. I am still on top of it.
Second swat lands heavier than the first.
One swat and you can't stand.
This paw is coming at you!
In the bamboo grove there's nowhere to retreat.
Hiding behind bamboo won't help.
It took countless pounces to aim this well.
A cat's paw is heavier than iron.
A shield won't stop this weight.
Watch. My paw's coming down.
Pulling back too slow — you stood too close.
Claws are in. Don't move.
My paw is wider than your sword.
One pounce, and you lie down.
Under the bamboo, my claws arrive first.
My paw is bigger than your face.
One paw pins you — stop struggling.
Get close and I swing by reflex.
That paw will lay you out a while.
Lie down. Don't force it.
Anyone who comes too close gets pounced.

lines.zh: 竹叶一响，我从深处走出来。
lines.en: Bamboo rustles; I step out of the deep.
This grove has had an owner for a long time.

lines.zh: 新来的气味，先标个记号。
lines.en: A new scent — I'll leave a mark first.

lines.zh: 我在树上磨爪，你听见了。
lines.en: I sharpen claws on bark; you heard it.

lines.zh: 这副身板从阴影里站起来。
lines.en: This bulk rises out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 步子不急，先看看谁在这。
lines.en: No hurry; first I see who's here.
The bamboo edge is my patrol.

lines.zh: 我落地没声，你别以为没人。
lines.en: I landed silent; don't think you're alone.

lines.zh: 橘黑条纹在绿里很显眼。
lines.en: Orange and black stands out against green.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，林子安静下来。
lines.en: One low growl and the forest quiets.
I came here looking for a meal.

lines.zh: 爪子先着地，眼睛后睁开。
lines.en: Paws land first; eyes open after.

lines.zh: 这片竹子，这次我要待久一点。
lines.en: This bamboo grove, I will stay longer.
Am I the only one in this bamboo?
That familiar bamboo smell again.
In the bamboo, my stripes are shadow.
Sniff around before I step.
First, find a trail to lie in wait.

lines.zh: 这片竹林，本来就是我巡的。
lines.en: This bamboo grove was always my patrol.
Bamboo's thick; I move slow.
Eyes open, first find water.
Just landed, stripes not even settled.
Crawled out of the dirt with a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 竹叶响了一下，是我的尾巴。
lines.en: The bamboo rustled. That was my tail.
Flame singes my stripes; the stench is foul.
Fur catches — I dive for water.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，爪子先着地。
lines.en: I fall from height and land on my paws.
Falling off the bamboo. Embarrassing.

lines.zh: 水漫过口鼻，我不擅长这个。
lines.en: Water covers my nose; this is not my element.
Water in my mouth.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，耳朵嗡响。
lines.en: The blast flips me; my ears ring.
The blast left my stripes trembling.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn.

lines.zh: 竹林太密，我的爪子刮到竹子上。
lines.en: The bamboo's too thick — my claws scraped it.

lines.zh: 那股怪力钻进骨头，甩不掉。
lines.en: That strange force seeps into my bones.
This spell makes my fur stand on end.
My belly is empty and my claws dull.
Hungry enough that my legs weaken.
Lightning strikes and my stripes glow.

lines.zh: 天在发怒，我的毛都竖起来了。
lines.en: The sky is furious, and my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，林子在我上面。
lines.en: The ground vanishes; the forest is above me.

lines.zh: 空中没地方借力，爪子空挥。
lines.en: Nothing to push off in the air. My claws swing at nothing.
